title: Wandering Trader Reborn
description: Enhanced wandering traders with configurable trade pools, restocking, modded item support and more!
body:
Traders now generate their inventories from fully configurable files. The default traders can be modified or removed, each with their own unique trade pool. A Legendary Trader can occasionally appear with amazing items.

## Features

- Fully configurable wandering trader inventories
- Create entirely new wandering traders
- Support for vanilla and modded items
- Configurable spawn timers
- Configurable restock timers
- Configurable wandering trader despawn behavior
- Configurable Legendary Trader spawn chance

Example command:
/wtr spawnrate 2h

Feel free to use this mod in your modpacks.
